title: What Inflatable Habitat Lines Is
definition: Inflatable Habitat Lines: production lines for inflatable habitats.
description:

t: The Signature Vision: Inflatable Habitat Lines
title: The Signature Vision: Inflatable Habitat Lines
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Inflatable Habitat Lines.
description:
The Signature vision of Inflatable Habitat Lines does not ask what committees will fund — it asks what physics allows and what engineering can compound.

Signature line hulls program, charter one: master fabric modules at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale line logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate pressure testing systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Inflatable Habitat Lines becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

title: 2030 — First line hulls districts certified: fabric modules assembly at

description:
First line hulls districts certified: fabric modules assembly at half the time and carbon of legacy builds.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed fabric modules demonstrations, line logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting pressure testing uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Inflatable Habitat Lines
definition: Estimates Inflatable Habitat Lines readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Inflatable Habitat Lines components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a line hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Inflatable Habitat Lines Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Inflatable Habitat Lines operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Inflatable Habitat Lines installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 77106 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where fabric modules monitoring, line logistics redundancy, or pressure testing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Inflatable Habitat Lines Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Inflatable Habitat Lines: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Inflatable Habitat Lines — production lines for inflatable habitats.

Phase 1 — Prove (fabric modules): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (line logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (pressure testing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (deployment): line hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and space-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
